A_uniform.what: one uniformly chosen edit; the unbiased accuracy number

B_adjacency.what: same-row horizontal neighbour substitution; PARTLY CIRCULAR, never merged into A

C1_control_lexicon.what: known-correct words, unmodified; correction rate must be ~0

C2_control_real.what: raw held-out tokens, unmodified, including proper nouns the lexicon lacks; the realistic false-correction rate

known_limitations: Synthetic typos. Real typing errors are not uniformly distributed and include errors this generator cannot make, such as whole-word substitutions and phonetic spellings.
Source words come from encyclopedic prose, so the register is wrong for a phone keyboard.
Corpus B is partly circular by construction and must never be quoted as the engine's accuracy.
